name: Jovvie Point of Sale POS for WooCommerce
author: bizswoop

sections.description:
Jovvie is the point of sale that runs on WooCommerce itself. There is no second product catalog, no separate customer list and no sync job to babysit: the register reads and writes the same WooCommerce data your online store uses. Install the plugin, connect your free BizSwoop account, and start selling in person in minutes on an iPad, Android tablet, phone, laptop or desktop.

Your first 25 orders are free, so you can run real sales before choosing a plan.

Why merchants pick Jovvie

  • One store, two channels – Products, prices, stock, customers, coupons and orders are shared with your online store in real time. Sell a unit in the shop and the website is updated instantly, so you never oversell.
  • Take cards in person, your way – Jovvie is an official Stripe Partner: accept credit, debit, Apple Pay and Google Pay with Stripe Terminal readers (S700 series, WisePad 3, M2 Reader) or Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android. Not on Stripe? Use NMI card terminals or any payment gateway already enabled in WooCommerce. Card data never touches your WordPress site.
  • Bring your own device – Any modern browser plus optional native apps for iOS and Android. No proprietary POS hardware or monthly hardware rental.
  • Built for real counters – Per-station settings, employee logins with PIN switching, cash drawer sessions, kiosk mode, receipts and kitchen printing, split payments and tips.
  • International ready – 36 languages, 100+ currencies and station-level currency selection. Used in 30+ countries.
  • Reports where you already work – POS sales appear in WooCommerce Analytics with user, station, gateway and cash-till breakdowns.

How it works

Jovvie is two parts working together:

  1. This plugin runs on your WordPress site. It exposes a secure POS API on top of WooCommerce and stores every sale as a normal WooCommerce order.
  2. The Jovvie POS app is the register interface. It is hosted by BizSwoop so it stays fast and up to date on every device, and it connects to your site through this plugin. A self-hosted POS UI plugin is also available if you prefer to run the interface on your own server.

You need a free BizSwoop account to connect the two. Your first 25 orders are free; after that a Basic or Pro plan is required. See current plans at jovvie.com/pricing.

Perfect For

Jovvie is used by retail shops, restaurants, pop-ups, events and multi-location businesses in 30+ countries.

  • Retail stores – Barcode scanning, variable products, customer profiles, receipt printing and stock counts.
  • Restaurants, cafes and counters – Fast checkout, tipping, kitchen printing, quick product tabs.
  • Pop-ups, markets and events – Portable setup on any phone or tablet with a Stripe reader or Tap to Pay.
  • Multi-location businesses – Multiple stations and locations with centralized WooCommerce reporting and per-station inventory.

5 Minute Easy Setup Video

In just a few clicks, a fully functional point of sale is connected to your WooCommerce store and ready to take orders.

Follow the Quick Start Guide for a step-by-step walkthrough, or watch a full tour:

Features

Payments

  • Stripe Terminal – Tap, swipe and insert with official Stripe hardware (S700 series, WisePad 3, M2 Reader).
  • Tap to Pay – Accept contactless cards and wallets directly on iPhone and Android devices, no reader required.
  • NMI card terminals – Swipe, insert and tap through NMI-connected devices.
  • Every WooCommerce gateway – Use any payment gateway already enabled on your store at the register.
  • Built-in POS methods – Cash, check, bank transfer, gift cards, QR code, chip and PIN, and “other” tenders for offline payment types.
  • Split payments – Take more than one payment method on a single order.
  • Tips – Configurable tip presets and custom amounts at checkout.
  • Refunds – Full or partial refunds with predefined reason codes and permission controls.
  • Multi-currency – Station-level currency selection with correct rounding for 100+ currencies.

Products and Inventory

  • Real-time sync – Products, pricing, categories and stock levels stay in sync with WooCommerce automatically.
  • Barcode scanning – USB, Bluetooth or camera-based scanners with GTIN, UPC, EAN, ISBN and SKU support.
  • Variable products and add-ons – Full support for variations, product add-ons, custom products and weight-based items.
  • Product tabs and unified search – Custom tab layouts, category filtering and one search box across products, customers and orders.
  • Multi-location inventory – Track stock per station or location with Station Stock counts, close-outs and order corrections.

Customers and Team

  • Customer management – Search, create and edit customer profiles at the register by name, email or phone.
  • Employee logins – Individual cashier and manager accounts with role-based permissions.
  • Passcode switching – Fast PIN switching between team members on a shared device, with auto-lock.

Operations

  • Receipt and kitchen printing – Connect receipt printers, kitchen printers and cash drawer kick via BizPrint.
  • Customer notifications – Send text, email and WhatsApp order alerts via FlowNotify.
  • Reporting – POS analytics inside WooCommerce Analytics with user, station, gateway and cash-till reports, plus per-station CSV export.
  • Cash management – Cash drawer tracking with open, count and close workflows and variance reporting.
  • Kiosk mode – Lock a device to a single station for self-service or dedicated terminals.
  • Coupons – Apply WooCommerce coupons directly from the POS.
  • Tax handling – Inclusive and exclusive tax with multiple tax classes and per-station tax settings.
  • Light and dark mode – Theme colors to match your brand.

Integrations

  • WooCommerce Subscriptions
  • WooCommerce Gift Cards
  • WooCommerce Points and Rewards
  • WooCommerce Product Add-ons and BizSwoop Product Add-ons
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatible

Jovvie beyond WooCommerce

Take the same in-person card payments in the other tools you already run:

  • Jovvie In-Person Payments for GiveWP – Tap to Pay and Stripe Terminal donations at events and fundraisers.
  • Jovvie Payments Gateway for The Events Calendar – Sell tickets in person with Event Tickets.
  • Jovvie Payments Gateway for Gravity Forms – Take card payments on Gravity Forms submissions.

External Services

Jovvie connects your site to the BizSwoop cloud (bizswoop.app) to run the hosted POS app and, if you use them, Stripe Terminal and Tap to Pay payments. Nothing is sent until you connect a BizSwoop account, and card details are handled by Stripe and never pass through your WordPress site. See the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

More Information

  • Website: jovvie.com
  • Quick Start Guide
  • All Features
  • Pricing
  • Video walkthroughs
  • Documentation
  • Support
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce if you have not already.
  2. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from Plugins > Add New by searching “Jovvie”.
  3. Activate the plugin, then open Point of Sale in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Click Connect and sign in with a free BizSwoop account (or create one).
  5. Create your first station, pick the users who may access it, and open the POS on any device.

The whole flow is covered in the Quick Start Guide.
sections.faq:
How do I get started?

Install the plugin, create a free BizSwoop account, and follow the quick start guide. Most stores are taking orders in under 5 minutes.

Is Jovvie free?

Your first 25 orders are free, so you can test real sales. After that a Basic or Pro plan is required. Current plans are at jovvie.com/pricing.

Do I need an account?

Yes. A BizSwoop account links your WooCommerce site to the hosted Jovvie POS app and manages your plan. Creating one is free.

Where does my data live?

In your WooCommerce store. Products, customers and orders are read from and written to your own database; the POS app is the interface, not a second copy of your store.

What hardware do I need?

Any device with a modern browser. For card payments, connect a Stripe Terminal reader (S700 series, WisePad 3 or M2), use Tap to Pay on iOS or Android, or an NMI-connected terminal. Receipt printers and cash drawers connect through BizPrint. No proprietary POS hardware is required.

Can I use my existing WooCommerce payment gateways?

Yes. Any gateway enabled in WooCommerce can be offered at the register alongside Stripe Terminal and the built-in cash, check, gift card and split-payment methods.

Does the POS work offline?

Jovvie needs an internet connection to sync with your WooCommerce store and to process card payments. The cart is preserved locally if the connection drops briefly, but orders are completed when the store is reachable.

Does it support multiple locations or registers?

Yes. Create as many stations as you need, each with its own users, gateways, currency, tax and display settings, and track inventory per station.

Do you provide support?

Yes. We actively develop and support both the plugin and the Jovvie POS app. Submit a support request, report bugs or request features at jovvie.com/support.

Can I request features?

Absolutely. Use Jovvie Support and label the request as a Feature Request.

Jovvie connects your site to the BizSwoop cloud (bizswoop.app) to run the hosted POS app and, if you use them, Stripe Terminal and Tap to Pay payments. Nothing is sent until you connect a BizSwoop account, and card details are handled by Stripe and never pass through your WordPress site. See the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
